phases.title: Baseline authority fixtures and measurement gates
phases.goal: Freeze the v2.3.0 research anchor, artifact authority boundaries, package doctor baseline, and token-footprint measurement gates before product behavior changes.

phases.title: Target lifecycle wrapper parity
phases.goal: Implement and verify the v2.3.0 wrapper for target registration, Active Target defaulting, targetSource reporting, and historical successor evidence across core, CLI, and MCP.

phases.title: Core diagnostics and query envelope foundation
phases.goal: Normalize diagnostics, parser warnings, query records, and mutation envelopes in shared Node.js services before adapter-level compact reads.

phases.title: CLI and MCP compact requirement reads
phases.goal: Expose compact requirement search, diagnostics-preserving read errors, and CLI/MCP parity over the shared query and diagnostic foundation.

phases.title: Runtime signature parity gate
phases.goal: Move runtime signature parity ahead of repair and migration work so CLI help, MCP schemas, docs, managed instructions, and skills cannot drift from implemented tool contracts.

phases.title: Safe SRS mutation previews and structured editing
phases.goal: Add safe preview parity, note-preserving mutation envelopes, structured requirement editing, and generated index rollups over shared core mutation services.

phases.title: SRS status cache and lock controls
phases.goal: Implement derived .status cache rebuilding and SRS lock denial/override semantics without letting cache or lock files become a requirements authority.

phases.title: External completed work log
phases.goal: Move Completed Work Log parsing and writes to an external-log capable parser/core/CLI/MCP surface without adding target-lifecycle work into this phase.

phases.title: Workflow artifact resolver and JSONL utilities
phases.goal: Create shared workflow artifact resolution and JSONL utility services as product code, using skill-local parsers only as migration references.

phases.title: Workflow validators journal identity and projections
phases.goal: Add official workflow validators, canonical journal identity, and read-only diagnostic projection contracts over the resolver/JSONL foundation.

phases.title: Read-only legacy workflow migration preview
phases.goal: Add the read-only legacy workflow migration preview core and CLI surface, explicitly forbidding apply/write behavior.

phases.title: Workflow artifact read surfaces
phases.goal: Expose compact CLI and MCP workflow artifact reads/resources over the shared resolver and projection services.

phases.title: Next work-order and read projections
phases.goal: Implement deterministic next work-order and profile projections as read-only products over validated workflow state.

phases.title: Guarded workflow mutation surfaces
phases.goal: Add guarded plan/checklist/status/pipeline/worklog/repair mutations with dry-run, stale guards, idempotency, and CLI/MCP parity.

phases.title: Workflow logical deletion effective state
phases.goal: Implement logical-delete tombstones, includeDeleted read boundaries, and CLI/MCP delete-state commands without physical deletion or restore semantics.

phases.title: Requirement ID collision diagnostics and repair core
phases.goal: Add grouped duplicate-ID diagnostics and a guarded diagnose/plan/apply core repair service before exposing merge-time repair workflows.

phases.title: Requirement ID repair CLI MCP and merge workflow
phases.goal: Expose duplicate-ID repair through CLI and MCP, then document the merge-time workflow after signature parity is in place.

phases.title: Kiwi skill migration and runtime mirror coverage
phases.goal: Migrate canonical and runtime-installed Kiwi skills to official workflow tools only after read, mutation, deletion, repair, and signature parity contracts exist.
